notes.note: #0.30-43 (block starts in story_092) and #0.46-59: 14-slot leader blocks (+29+k, +45+k). Script order: W has its own branch (#0.1-8); k = OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Seven, Taro, Ultraman, Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. So #0.37-43 = Mebius..00, all identical 'Museum?'.
Taboo: 'Gaoh's gang' as in story_092 #0.7. 'Kaku Cube' read as each of the Cubes; subject 'I' restored.

Voiced per slot order: #0.47 Momotaros (rough 'ou! jaa kiku kedo yo'), #0.54 Zero ('daro na'), #0.48/50-52/58-59 identical formal 'naraba... to iu wake da na' (RX, Seven, Taro, Ultraman, Wing Zero, 00), #0.49 Rider 1 ends with '?' only. Quotes kept for the bracketed term (story_082/092 practice).
Jewel Dopant (g n): 'kizutsukeru koto wa dekinai' = cannot be scratched/damaged.
Arms Dopant: 'yakkai ni natte iru' = being put up here as a hanger-on; rendered 'crashin' with this lot'.

Extractor labels Den-O Sword Form, but the script sets the speaker from the party check (CHARA_NAME.3 is only the default). OOO is checked first, so it is usually OOO answering Ankh; mild 'sou da ne' kept neutral.
Door inscription, archaic 'Ware, GAIA no kioku wo hossu'. GAIA kept in caps as in the source (G-A-I-A letter puzzle).

14-slot leader block (+5+k). Script order: OOO, W, Rider 1, Nu, Seven, Ultraman, Taro, Zeta, Mebius, God, RX, Wing Zero, 00, Zero (Den-O falls back to slot 4). #0.14 polite '-mashou' = Mebius; #0.16 energetic = RX; identical Japanese kept identical.
Memory exhibits follow story_094's template (caption layout, caps voice call, 'CLANG!!', door line, Ankh line). Gene/Magma/T-Rex use official W names; 'T-Rex' per glossary T-Rex Dopant.
Ankh 'yatta na' rendered '...That did it!' to match story_094.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant blocks voiced from the event scripts' Pt_Chara_Check order. Uncertain: 0521 #0.2 speaker (labelled Den-O, probably OOO via party register). Not in glossary: Museum (W organization, as story_092), Gene/Magma/T-Rex Memory (official W names).
